suites.notes: Includes a complete provider-free 216-call scientific-runner execution, pause after four persisted calls, exact resume, terminal checkpoint sealing at 216/217, five-view terminal agreement, immutable terminal resume rejection, idempotent finalization, scorer-failure non-completion, false-clean, malformed output, model/config drift, global lease, Activity, coding isolation, and scorer arithmetic. Adds the R2 regressions: non-hashable list elements are classified by the gold-blind validator across research, synthesis and planning, and a full 216-call run completes with a non-hashable answer preserved as false-clean scientific data.

Adds evaluator-side adversarial coverage of uncertainties, citations and lineages carrying objects, lists, mixed text-and-object, and non-list values, plus proof that all-text elements are judged exactly as before the repair.
Adds byte-for-byte preservation of the superseded R1 fixture freeze and proof that corpus, gold and prompt profiles did not change across the validator repair.
Historical and current pilot isolation, pause/resume, terminal immutability, and scientific-freeze binding regressions.

differential_over_preserved_r2_records.notes: Every persisted R2 observation was re-validated with the repaired validators. Operational acceptance, semantic hard-gate outcome and reason lists are identical, so the repair converts crashes into recorded failures and changes no observed judgment.
